podcast.body: This song, described as an "ode to the joys of female masturbation," reached number three on the charts. It showcased Cyndi Lauper's daring persona and contributed to her making history by pulling four top five hits from her debut album. "the number three shebop."

podcast.body: This track was among Cyndi Lauper's quartet of top-ten hits released or peaking in 1984, solidifying her superstar status. "Girls just want to have fun, time after time, she-bop, and all through the night. All of which were released or peaked in 1984."
